text: Among 20th-century and living-generation artists, how many are painters, sculptors, photographers, or something else?
Among artists with at least one recorded award, how many were born on each continent?
Among artists who taught, how many are associated with each century?
Among awarded artists with a recorded age, what is the average age by birth continent?
Among American, French, British, or German artists aged 40 to 90, how many fall into each century?
Among artists with a portrait dominated by earth tones, blue, red, or black-and-white, how many fall into each tone family?
Among teachers with no recorded awards, which image genres appear at least three times?
Among Expressionist, Impressionist, Surrealist, or Realist artists, how many use each major color family?
Among awarded artists who taught, how many are associated with each century?
Among painters aged 50 to 90, how many were born on each continent?
Among artists with a known art institution, what is the average award count by century?
Among awarded European-born artists, how many are associated with each century?
Among artists born in the United States, France, the United Kingdom, Germany, or Italy, how many are painters, sculptors, photographers, or something else?
Among artists with bright- or dark-toned works, which styles appear at least five times?
Among artists who died in a different country from where they were born, how many were born on each continent?
Among artists working in abstract, landscape, or portrait genres, how many are associated with each century?
Among artists aged 80 to 105, how many taught versus did not teach?
Among artists of known age with a portrait, landscape, still-life, or abstract work, what is the average age for each tone family?
Among artists with at least two awards, which nationalities appear at least twice?
Among artists whose work has an asymmetrical composition, how many are associated with each century?
